# Typography setup — ultra-modern-lovable-style

All fonts are free via Google Fonts.

## HTML <head>
```html
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,700&family=Inter:wght@400;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

## Tailwind config
```js
fontFamily: {
  serif: ['Fraunces', 'Georgia', 'serif'],
  sans: ['Inter', '-apple-system', 'sans-serif'],
  mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'Menlo', 'monospace']
}
```

## Variable axes usage (Fraunces)
- `font-feature-settings: 'opsz' var(--opsz);` for optical-size-tied responsive sizing
- Combine `--opsz: 96` for hero headings, `--opsz: 18` for body display
